name: Oliver Davies
bio:
Oliver Davies discovered his passion for motorsport through his family's long-standing involvement with local racing events. Growing up near Silverstone, he was immersed in the world of Formula One from a young age. Oliver honed his communication skills through volunteer work at smaller racing teams, managing their social media and securing local press coverage. He is known for his creative approach to PR, focusing on crafting engaging narratives that resonate with fans and sponsors alike.

Joining the Caterham Academy was a dream come true for Oliver. He thrives on the fast-paced environment and the challenge of promoting emerging talent. His strength lies in his ability to connect with drivers on a personal level, translating their stories into compelling content. Oliver is dedicated to building a strong brand for the team and its drivers, ensuring they receive the recognition they deserve. He believes in transparency and authenticity, fostering open communication between the team and its fanbase.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a side parting
physical.description: Oliver is of average height with a lean build and a friendly, approachable demeanor.
